sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily, today.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》，今日话题。

sentences.en: Behind President Biden's decision to mandate vaccinations for 100 million Americans, and why the political backlash it's already unleashing could ultimately work to his benefit.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统决定强制要求1亿美国人接种疫苗，以及为什么由此引发的政治反弹最终可能反而对他有利。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, White House reporter Jim Tankersley.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事，白宫记者吉姆·坦克斯利。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: Jim, the last time that we talked about government mandates for COVID-19 vaccines on the show,
sentences.zh: 吉姆，上次我们在节目中讨论政府强制接种新冠疫苗时，

sentences.en: President Biden was in a very different place.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统的态度还大不相同。

sentences.en: He was deeply skeptical of them and unprepared to order them.
sentences.zh: 他当时对此深表怀疑，也没有准备好下达强制令。

sentences.en: And that was really only a month and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 那其实才是一个半月前的事。

sentences.en: So what has changed?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么改变了呢？

sentences.en: I think what changed is the president has grown increasingly frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我认为改变的是总统越来越感到沮丧。

sentences.en: It works.
sentences.zh: 它有效。

sentences.en: It's safe.
sentences.zh: 它安全。

sentences.en: It's free.
sentences.zh: 它免费。

sentences.en: It's convenient.
sentences.zh: 它方便。

sentences.en: He embarked on this months-long campaign to try to convince holdouts that, no, it's safe to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他开展了长达数月的运动，试图说服那些持观望态度的人：不，接种疫苗是安全的。

sentences.en: It's the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的做法。

sentences.en: The vaccine saves lives and it could save yours or your child's.
sentences.zh: 疫苗可以挽救生命，也能挽救你或你孩子的生命。

sentences.en: He had a lot of public events where he came out and implored people to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他参加了许多公开活动，恳求人们接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Folks, there's no reason to leave yourself vulnerable to the deadly virus for one single day more.
sentences.zh: 各位，没有理由让自己再多一天暴露在这个致命病毒的威胁之下。

sentences.en: Encouraging states to use federal money to pay people to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 鼓励各州利用联邦资金支付人们接种疫苗的费用。

sentences.en: Like, they tried every possible way, the White House believes,
sentences.zh: 白宫认为，他们尝试了所有可能的方法，

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 拜托了。

sentences.en: to nudge.
sentences.zh: 去推动。

sentences.en: Please get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 请去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: the unvaccinated into getting vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 未接种疫苗的人去接种。

sentences.en: But the White House has come to believe they've hit their limit on voluntary vaccination.
sentences.zh: 但白宫已经开始认为，他们在自愿接种方面已经到了极限。

sentences.en: They're not going to persuade many more people to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他们无法再说服更多人接种疫苗了。

sentences.en: And they are seeing the consequences of sort of hitting that wall.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正在看到撞上这堵墙的后果。

sentences.en: The big one, the one that the White House says is driving this shift, is public health.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点，也是白宫所说推动这一转变的原因，是公共卫生。

sentences.en: We are seeing mounting death rates across the country from the virus at a time when we were supposed to be getting through the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在我们本应度过疫情的时候，全国各地的病毒死亡率却在不断上升。

sentences.en: But there are other consequences, too.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他后果。

sentences.en: The economy is suffering from the Delta wave.
sentences.zh: 经济正受到德尔塔变异株的冲击。

sentences.en: We saw job growth slow in August in industries that are sort of most exposed to COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们看到8月份就业增长在受新冠影响最严重的行业中放缓。

sentences.en: Consumers are pulling back on spending in places like restaurants and airline travel.
sentences.zh: 消费者在餐饮和航空旅行等方面的支出正在缩减。

sentences.en: The consumer confidence has crashed.
sentences.zh: 消费者信心已经崩溃。

sentences.en: So, in general, the recovery is at risk from this new phase of the pandemic, all of which culminates in the president's poll numbers, which have sagged in recent months,
sentences.zh: 所以，总的来说，复苏正受到疫情新阶段的威胁，所有这些都体现在总统的支持率上，近几个月来支持率一直在下滑，

sentences.en: partly because of what's happened in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是阿富汗发生的事情。

sentences.en: But a big driver of them appears to be even former strong supporters of the president growing disenchanted with this handling of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但其中一个主要驱动因素似乎是，即使是总统曾经的坚定支持者，也对他处理疫情的方式感到失望。

sentences.en: So, those political forces, economic forces, and primarily the public health force come together for a president who's frustrated.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些政治力量、经济力量，以及最主要的公共卫生力量，汇聚在了一位感到沮丧的总统身上。

sentences.en: And the White House has basically asked the question, what else can we do?
sentences.zh: 白宫基本上提出了一个问题：我们还能做什么？

sentences.en: All of this frustration comes to a head in the speech that the president gives on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 所有这些沮丧情绪在总统周四发表的演讲中达到了顶点。

sentences.en: Good evening, my fellow Americans.
sentences.zh: 各位美国同胞，晚上好。

sentences.en: And the president walks out and we see a very different Joe Biden when it comes to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 总统走上台，我们看到了一个在疫情问题上完全不同的乔·拜登。

sentences.en: This is a pandemic of the unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 这是一场未接种疫苗者的疫情。

sentences.en: And it's caused by the fact that despite America having unprecedented and successful vaccination
sentences.zh: 这是因为尽管美国拥有前所未有的成功疫苗接种

sentences.en: program, despite the fact that for almost five months, free vaccines have been available in 80,000 different locations, we still have nearly 80 million Americans who have failed
sentences.zh: 计划，尽管近五个月来，8万个不同地点都提供免费疫苗，但我们仍有近8000万美国人没有

sentences.en: to get the shot.
sentences.zh: 去接种。

sentences.en: Instead of pleading with people to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他不再恳求人们去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And a distinct minority of Americans, supported by a distinct minority of elected officials, are keeping us from turning the corner.
sentences.zh: 一小部分美国人，在极少数民选官员的支持下，阻碍了我们走出困境。

sentences.en: He takes a very sharp aim at unvaccinated people.
sentences.zh: 他将矛头直指未接种疫苗的人。

sentences.en: We've been patient, but our patience is wearing thin.
sentences.zh: 我们一直很有耐心，但我们的耐心正在耗尽。

sentences.en: And your refusal has cost all of us.
sentences.zh: 你们的拒绝让所有人都付出了代价。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There was none of that conciliatory tone that I think of when I think about how President
sentences.zh: 当我想到拜登总统谈论这场疫情的方式时，他完全没有那种和解的语气。

sentences.en: Biden has talked about this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他直截了当地说，你们中的一群人，虽然人数不多，但已经足够多了。

sentences.en: He is flat out saying, a bunch of you, and it's not that many of you, but it's enough.
sentences.zh: 你们简直是在毁掉我们所有人的生活。

sentences.en: You're literally ruining everything for the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 他确实站出来说，基本上，我们等待你们去做我们认为正确的事情的时间已经结束了。

sentences.en: He is really coming out and says, basically, our time of waiting for you to do what we believe is the right thing is over.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要尽一切努力强迫你们去做。

sentences.en: And now we're going to do everything we can to make you do it.
sentences.zh: 作为你们的总统，我今晚宣布一项新计划，要求更多美国人接种疫苗，以打击那些阻碍公共卫生的人。

sentences.en: As your president, I'm announcing tonight a new plan to require more Americans to be vaccinated to combat those blocking public health.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 详细描述一下他在演讲中提出的建议。

sentences.en: Describe in detail the proposals that he laid out in the speech.
sentences.zh: 他提议的核心是一系列针对各行各业工人的疫苗强制令。

sentences.en: The headline of what he proposes is a sort of suite of mandates for workers in various places to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 首先是联邦工作人员和数百万与政府有业务往来的联邦承包商。

sentences.en: So that starts with federal workers and millions of federal contractors that do business with the government.
sentences.zh: 如果你想与联邦政府合作并开展业务，就去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: If you want to work with the federal government and do business with this, get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 没有如果、而且或但是。

sentences.en: No ifs, ands, or buts.
sentences.zh: 没有办法通过检测或其他方式来规避。

sentences.en: There's no ability to get out of that with testing or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你必须接种疫苗。

sentences.en: You have to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我的计划将扩大我之前在医疗保健领域发布的疫苗接种要求。

sentences.en: My plan will extend the vaccination requirements that I previously issued in the health care field.
sentences.zh: 他还要求大约1700万在医疗机构和医院工作的医护人员接种新冠疫苗，这些机构基本上都接受联邦资金。

sentences.en: He then also requires COVID vaccinations for some 17 million health care workers who work in health care settings and hospitals that basically take federal money.
sentences.zh: 我们将要求所有治疗医疗保险和医疗补助患者的疗养院工作人员接种疫苗，因为我有这项联邦授权。

sentences.en: We'll be requiring vaccinations and all nursing home workers who treat patients on Medicare and Medicaid because I have that federal authority.
sentences.zh: 这是利用这些医院与联邦政府之间的财务关系，基本上是说你们需要有自己的疫苗强制令，

sentences.en: This is leveraging a financial relationship between those hospitals and the federal government to basically say you need to have your own vaccination mandates,
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，其中许多地方已经有了。

sentences.en: which to be clear, many of those places already have.
sentences.zh: 但他是在说，如果你是这些与政府有业务往来的医疗服务提供者之一，我将设定一个统一的标准。

sentences.en: But he's saying, you know, I'm going to set a consistent standard if you are one of these, you know, health care providers who does business with the government.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Gotcha.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的一项，真正重要的一项，是覆盖大型私营企业员工的强制令。

sentences.en: But the big one, the really big one, is a mandate that covers private sector workers in large companies.
sentences.zh: 我们要保护已接种疫苗的员工免受未接种疫苗同事的伤害。

sentences.en: We're going to protect vaccinated workers from unvaccinated co-workers.
sentences.zh: 那项强制令具体是怎么说的？

sentences.en: And what exactly does that mandate say?
sentences.zh: 嗯，它说如果你是一家拥有超过100名员工的公司，你必须要求员工接种疫苗，或者要求他们每周进行一次新冠检测。

sentences.en: Well, it says that if you are a company with more than 100 workers, you have to require vaccines of your employees or require them to be tested for COVID once a week.
sentences.zh: 这与自由或个人选择无关。

sentences.en: This is not about freedom or personal choice.
sentences.zh: 这是为了保护你自己和你周围的人。

sentences.en: It's about protecting yourself and those around you.
sentences.zh: 否则，你就违反了联邦安全法规。

sentences.en: And otherwise, you are afoul of federal safety regulations.
sentences.zh: 据白宫估计，这适用于大约8000万名工人。

sentences.en: And this applies to probably 80 million workers by the White House's estimate.
sentences.zh: 是的，这涵盖了经济的很大一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just a huge swath of the economy.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人，以及所有继续在抗疫一线服务的人们。

sentences.en: God bless you all and all those who continue to serve on the front lines of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 感觉针对联邦工作人员或依赖联邦资金的工人的强制令，尽管范围很广，但非常直观，因为总统要么控制他们的工作，

sentences.en: It feels like the mandate for federal workers or workers who rely on federal money, as sweeping as those are, is very intuitive because the president either controls their job
sentences.zh: 要么控制他们的资金。

sentences.en: or controls their money.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是他的员工。

sentences.en: They're essentially his workforce.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所暗示的那样，针对私营企业员工的这项强制令感觉非常新颖，而且出人意料。

sentences.en: But this mandate for workers at private companies, as you're hinting at, that feels very novel and it feels unexpected.
sentences.zh: 那么它的依据是什么？

sentences.en: So what is the basis for that?
sentences.zh: 这在总统看来几乎有点越权了。

sentences.en: It almost feels like a bit of a stretch for the president.
sentences.zh: 它的依据是1970年的一项法律，该法律在劳工部内设立了职业安全与健康管理局，

sentences.en: What it is, is a law from 1970 that set up the Occupational Safety and Health Administration
sentences.zh: 即OSHA。当你读到关于OSHA的报道时，通常是因为它在调查工作场所事故或化学品泄漏。

sentences.en: inside the Labor Department called OSHA, which often when you read about OSHA, it's because it's investigating workplace accidents or chemical spills.
sentences.zh: 它的职责是保障工人安全并执行工作场所的安全标准。

sentences.en: It's charged with keeping workers safe and enforcing safety standards in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 但总统指示OSHA做的是实施一项要求，基本上是说，看，你们的工作场所存在巨大的安全威胁。

sentences.en: But what the president is directing OSHA to do is to implement a requirement basically that says, look, there's a huge threat to safety in your workplace.
sentences.zh: 那个威胁就是德尔塔变异株。

sentences.en: That threat is the Delta variant.
sentences.zh: 针对这个威胁有一种补救措施。

sentences.en: And there's a remedy for that threat.
sentences.zh: 你可以采取一种安全预防措施，那就是让每个人都接种疫苗。

sentences.en: There's a safety precaution you can take, which is to get everybody vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 所以为了拥有一个安全的工作场所，你需要采取这种安全预防措施。

sentences.en: And so you need to take that safety precaution in order to have a safe workplace.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 所以他正在利用现有的工作场所法规，将接种疫苗作为健康工作场所的条件。

sentences.en: So he's using existing workplace regulations to require vaccinations as a condition of a healthy workplace.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 不过我很好奇，OSHA对私营部门的强制令到底有多大的执行力。

sentences.en: I'm curious, though, how enforceable the private sector mandate really is by OSHA.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些成千上万拥有100多名员工的办公室里，这到底该如何运作？

sentences.en: How exactly is this supposed to work in all these hundreds of thousands of offices with more than 100 people?
sentences.zh: 我认为它运作的主要方式，至少在初期，只是通过促使人们自行采取行动，无论是员工、雇主还是双方。

sentences.en: I think the big way it's supposed to work, at least initially, is just by prodding people to act on their own, whether it's employees or employers or both.
sentences.zh: 如果OSHA没有足够的检查员和监管人员去全国每一个大型工作场所查看他们是否在执行这项规定，这就像竖起一个新的限速标志一样。

sentences.en: If OSHA doesn't have nearly enough inspectors, regulators to go to every large job site in the country and see if they're implementing this, it's a lot like putting up a new sign
sentences.zh: 你可能没有足够的警力让每一辆警车每天都在路上检查每一位司机的速度。

sentences.en: for a reduced speed limit.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅竖起那个标志就足以让很多人减速了。

sentences.en: You probably don't have the police resources to have a car, a police car on the road every day checking every driver's speed.
sentences.zh: 这就是白宫在这里所押注的，即在宣布后的最初几天或几周内，企业会做出反应并说，嘿，我们想遵守法律，所以你们都需要接种疫苗，或者你们都需要接受检测。

sentences.en: But just putting up the sign is going to be enough to get a lot of people to slow down.
sentences.zh: 本质上，公司和员工会进行自我监管。

sentences.en: And that's what the White House is betting on here is that in the early days, weeks of this announcement, businesses are going to react and say, hey, we want to comply with the
sentences.zh: 他们只是希望这一宣布本身就能激励许多人和企业采取行动。

sentences.en: law, so you all need to get vaccinated or you all need to subject the tests.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，反弹会有多大？

sentences.en: Essentially, there will be self-policing by companies and employees.
sentences.zh: 白宫会因此成功提高疫苗接种率吗？

sentences.en: And they are just hoping that the sheer fact of the announcement motivates a lot of people and businesses to act.
sentences.zh: 还是他们会彻底让很多人和企业对这个想法产生反感？

sentences.en: But the question is, how big will the backlash be?
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 嗯，在宣布后的第一时间，保守派阵营的反应迅速而愤怒。

sentences.en: day.
sentences.zh: 听着，这不是下放给联邦政府的权力。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 这是各州决定的权力。

sentences.en: So, Jim, what has the backlash been in the few days since Biden announced these sweeping mandates?
sentences.zh: 特别是保守派议员。

sentences.en: Well, in the immediate aftermath of the announcement, it was swift and angry from conservative corners.
sentences.zh: 在南达科他州，我们将保持自由，并确保我们不会越权。

sentences.en: Listen, this is not a power that is delegated to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 许多红州的州长站出来说……

sentences.en: This is a power for states to decide.
sentences.zh: 当像拜登这样的总统对美国人民发布违宪法令时，我们有责任捍卫宪法并进行反击。

sentences.en: Particularly conservative lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 誓言要在这件事上与总统抗争？

sentences.en: In South Dakota, we're going to be free and we're going to make sure that we don't overstep our authorities.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A lot of governors of red states came out and...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，OSHA监管的是有毒化学品和不安全的脚手架之类的东西。

sentences.en: When you have a president like Biden issuing unconstitutional edicts against the American people, we have a responsibility to stand up for the Constitution and to fight back.
sentences.zh: 他们不监管流行病。

sentences.en: Vowed to fight the president on this?
sentences.zh: 所以这显然是一个能激发保守派基础的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个政治干扰。

sentences.en: I mean, OSHA regulates toxic chemicals and like unsafe scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 它很可能是非法的，而且几乎可以肯定会适得其反。

sentences.en: They don't regulate epidemics.
sentences.zh: 他们并不监管流行病。

sentences.en: So this is obviously an issue that energizes the conservative base.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然是一个能激发保守派选民热情的问题。

sentences.en: It's just a political distraction.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是政治上的干扰项。

sentences.en: It's probably unlawful and it's almost certainly counterproductive.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是违法的，而且几乎可以肯定会适得其反。

sentences.en: And so lawmakers, including members of Congress, have been very agitated about it for what they see as violation of the Constitution and abuse of his powers as president.
sentences.zh: 因此，包括国会议员在内的立法者们对此感到非常不安，因为他们认为这违反了宪法，并滥用了总统职权。

sentences.en: And what exactly are these conservative lawmakers arguing is wrong with the president's mandates here?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些保守派立法者究竟认为总统的这些强制令有什么问题呢？

sentences.en: There are two big things they're arguing.
sentences.zh: 他们主要提出了两点论据。

sentences.en: The first is they are arguing the president has overstepped his authority, that this is
sentences.zh: 首先，他们认为总统越权了，认为这

sentences.en: something that, you know, the federal government should not have the ability to do with private
sentences.zh: 你知道，联邦政府本不应该有权对私营

sentences.en: businesses or, you know, in general, that OSHA should not have the ability to do, given the scope of the law that set it up.
sentences.zh: 企业采取这种行动，或者说，考虑到设立职业安全与健康管理局（OSHA）的法律范围，OSHA本不应有权这样做。

sentences.en: The other argument, though, that you hear a lot is about personal liberty.
sentences.zh: 不过，你经常听到的另一个论点是关于个人自由。

sentences.en: The idea that any government should not be able to tell people whether they should get vaccinated or not, even in the midst of a deadly pandemic, because it's personal liberty
sentences.zh: 即任何政府都不应有权告诉人们是否应该接种疫苗，即使是在致命的全球大流行期间，因为这是个人自由，

sentences.en: and the right of Americans to make those choices themselves.
sentences.zh: 也是美国人自己做出这些选择的权利。

sentences.en: And when it comes to the law, is there any credibility to the arguments being made that you just cited that this is an overstepping of the president and OSHA's authority?
sentences.zh: 说到法律，你刚才提到的关于总统和OSHA越权的论点有任何可信度吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's a pretty widespread agreement among many constitutional scholars that this could
sentences.zh: 嗯，许多宪法学者之间存在相当广泛的共识，认为这

sentences.en: very well be within the president's authority, that OSHA has wide leeway to declare what constitutes a safety emergency.
sentences.zh: 很可能在总统的职权范围内，因为OSHA在宣布什么是安全紧急情况方面拥有广泛的裁量权。

sentences.en: And this very well could fall in that power.
sentences.zh: 这很可能属于该权力范畴。

sentences.en: But there's also a real sense, particularly among conservative scholars, that the law is in the eyes
sentences.zh: 但人们也确实有一种感觉，特别是在保守派学者中，认为法律在

sentences.en: of the courts and that there will be very likely a judge somewhere who would be sympathetic to this
sentences.zh: 法院眼中自有评判，而且很可能会有某位法官对这一

sentences.en: legal challenge, possibly up to the United States Supreme Court could be sympathetic to this legal challenge.
sentences.zh: 法律挑战表示同情，甚至可能一直到美国最高法院，都可能对这一法律挑战表示同情。

sentences.en: So it both seems to be that the president is starting from what could be solid legal footing,
sentences.zh: 所以，总统似乎既是从一个可能稳固的法律基础出发，

sentences.en: but also could face some challenge in the courts just because of the way that interpretations of law change over time.
sentences.zh: 但也可能在法院面临一些挑战，仅仅是因为法律解释随时间变化的方式。

sentences.en: I would note that we do have some precedent of the Supreme Court holding up vaccine mandates.
sentences.zh: 我得指出，我们确实有最高法院支持疫苗强制令的先例。

sentences.en: It's from 1905.
sentences.zh: 那是1905年的事了。

sentences.en: The court basically found that people did not have the freedom at all times to be free from any kind of restraint from the government, including something like a vaccine mandate.
sentences.zh: 法院基本上裁定，人们并没有在任何时候都不受政府任何形式限制的自由，包括像疫苗强制令这样的事情。

sentences.en: So to the extent that that is a binding precedent, that would be on the president's side.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这是一个具有约束力的先例，那它将站在总统这一边。

sentences.en: But there are already conservative scholars arguing that, nope, it shouldn't apply here.
sentences.zh: 但已经有保守派学者辩称，不，它不应该适用于这里。

sentences.en: And I guess that's the battle we are very likely to see in the courts over the following weeks.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们在接下来的几周里很可能会在法庭上看到的较量。

sentences.en: So that's the legal battle.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是法律层面的较量。

sentences.en: But it feels quite likely that this will morph into a cultural battle as well, given the language that Republicans are using to talk about these mandates.
sentences.zh: 但考虑到共和党人在谈论这些强制令时所使用的语言，这很可能会演变成一场文化战争。

sentences.en: And it feels like a cultural battle with very big implications for the president and for Democrats in Congress.
sentences.zh: 而且这感觉像是一场对总统和国会民主党人有着重大影响的文化战争。

sentences.en: We are not that far out from midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 我们距离中期选举已经不远了。

sentences.en: And I wonder how the White House is thinking about that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道白宫对此有何考量。

sentences.en: Well, I think the first thing to note is that we're already in a cultural battle with this virus.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为首先要注意的是，我们已经在与这种病毒进行一场文化战争了。

sentences.en: And a distinct minority of this country has been fighting against almost every government move
sentences.zh: 这个国家的一小部分人一直在反对政府几乎所有的举措，

sentences.en: to impose mandates of any kind, whether it's masks or school shutdowns or a variety of things that local governments have done to slow the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 无论是口罩、学校停课，还是地方政府为减缓病毒传播所采取的各种措施，他们都反对强制令。

sentences.en: This is going to really energize and upset that slice of the country even more.
sentences.zh: 这确实会进一步激怒和搅动该国的那一部分人。

sentences.en: But the Biden administration, I think, based on conversations with people around them, is making sort of a double bet here.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，根据与拜登政府周围人士的交谈，拜登政府在这里进行了一种双重赌博。

sentences.en: One is that group is small and was probably not going to vote for Joe Biden anyway.
sentences.zh: 一是认为那个群体很小，而且无论如何可能都不会投票给乔·拜登。

sentences.en: They are hardcore conservative Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他们是坚定的保守派共和党人。

sentences.en: That's certainly not everyone who is unvaccinated, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，这当然不代表所有未接种疫苗的人。

sentences.en: But that is the sort of political activist class that will be activated even more by this mandate.
sentences.zh: 但那确实是那种会被这一强制令进一步激活的政治激进阶层。

sentences.en: But the second bet they're making is that there is a much larger group of people who are very important to this White House who feel the opposite, who are vaccinated, who want this
sentences.zh: 但他们进行的第二次赌博是，对于白宫来说非常重要的一大群人有着相反的感受，他们已经接种了疫苗，希望这场

sentences.en: pandemic to be over, who are sort of college educated people living in the suburbs, many
sentences.zh: 大流行结束，他们大多是住在郊区的受过大学教育的人，

sentences.en: of them, and who the White House believes will cheer the president coming out and doing more
sentences.zh: 白宫相信，当总统站出来做更多事情时，他们会为此欢呼，

sentences.en: as much as he possibly can, as the White House would put it, to try to end this pandemic as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 正如白宫所言，尽他所能，试图尽快结束这场大流行。

sentences.en: And his poll numbers were slipping with those people.
sentences.zh: 而他的民调数字在这些人中正在下滑。

sentences.en: They could be very important for who controls the House of Representatives next fall.
sentences.zh: 他们对于明年秋天谁能控制众议院可能非常重要。

sentences.en: That group is part of this, what the White House might think of as, a large majority of Americans
sentences.zh: 那个群体是白宫所认为的美国绝大多数人的一部分，

sentences.en: who are vaccinated, pro-vaccination, and just tired of this pandemic and want to see more action.
sentences.zh: 他们接种了疫苗，支持疫苗接种，只是厌倦了这场大流行，并希望看到更多的行动。

sentences.en: It feels worth remembering that Biden's entire campaign message by the end was,
sentences.zh: 值得记住的是，拜登竞选活动的最终信息是，

sentences.en: I'm going to be the one to end this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我将是那个结束这场大流行的人。

sentences.en: President Trump didn't.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统没有做到。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会做到。

sentences.en: And it feels like if he can't live up to that pledge, a big part of his presidency will have been unrealized.
sentences.zh: 如果他不能兑现这一承诺，他总统任期的一大部分将无法实现。

sentences.en: Yeah, and a lot more people will be dead because of it.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且会有更多的人因此而死亡。

sentences.en: You know, the administration has fashioned itself from the beginning as different from the previous administration in its response to the pandemic, in that they were going to
sentences.zh: 你知道，本届政府从一开始就将自己塑造为与前任政府在应对大流行方面有所不同，因为他们将

sentences.en: be much more aggressive in trying to stop it, whether that's distributing vaccines or getting people to get vaccinated or whatnot.
sentences.zh: 在试图阻止它方面更加积极，无论是分发疫苗、让人们接种疫苗还是其他什么。

sentences.en: And if they can't follow through on that, if we just keep seeing wave after wave after wave of deaths from new variants of the virus, and that ripples through to a bad economy and
sentences.zh: 如果他们不能贯彻这一点，如果我们只是不断看到病毒新变种引发的一波又一波的死亡，而这又波及到糟糕的经济和

sentences.en: more voter disenchantment, sort of the entire promise of the presidency will be lost and there will be huge consequences.
sentences.zh: 更多的选民不满，那么整个总统任期的承诺就会落空，并会产生巨大的后果。

sentences.en: And then I think that that is much more than just a political problem, obviously, for the president, but it's a deeply human one.
sentences.zh: 然后我认为，这显然不仅仅是总统面临的政治问题，更是一个深刻的人道问题。

sentences.en: And Jim, what happens if these mandates don't work and we see all those consequences you just described keep playing out?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，如果这些强制令不起作用，我们看到你刚才描述的所有后果持续发生，会怎样？

sentences.en: What tools does Biden really have left after he reaches deep into OSHA regulations and finds these mandates?
sentences.zh: 在深入研究OSHA法规并找到这些强制令后，拜登还剩下什么真正的工具？

sentences.en: Is that really his last big shot?
sentences.zh: 这真的是他最后的大招了吗？

sentences.en: This may be his last really big shot.
sentences.zh: 这可能是他最后真正的大招了。

sentences.en: No matter what he has left in the arsenal, I think there's probably only so much he can ask the American people to do.
sentences.zh: 无论他武器库里还剩下什么，我认为他能要求美国人民做的事情可能也就这么多了。

sentences.en: You know, experts talk about kind of a finite amount of tolerance people have for changing their behaviors, even for a global pandemic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，专家们谈论人们改变行为的容忍度是有限的，即使是面对全球大流行。

sentences.en: So it would be very difficult, I think, for the president to come out in a few months and say, hey, we all need to go back inside for a year to slow the spread.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为总统在几个月后站出来说，嘿，我们需要全部回到室内待一年来减缓传播，这将是非常困难的。

sentences.en: People are just not going to go for that anymore.
sentences.zh: 人们不会再买账了。

sentences.en: And so I think that part of the ambition of this announcement is reflective of the fact that the president doesn't have a lot of other options available to him and that American
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这一公告的部分雄心反映了这样一个事实：总统没有其他太多选择，而且美国

sentences.en: people, just like the president, are losing patience.
sentences.zh: 人民和总统一样，正在失去耐心。

sentences.en: They want this pandemic to be over and they want it to happen now.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这场大流行结束，而且希望现在就结束。

sentences.en: Well, Jim, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，吉姆，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: The Times reports that based on new data, the United States vaccination rate of 52.7% will
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，根据新数据，美国52.7%的疫苗接种率

sentences.en: soon be the lowest among the world's largest and wealthiest democracies.
sentences.zh: 很快将成为全球最大和最富裕民主国家中最低的。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has already fallen behind Britain, Canada, France, Germany, and Italy, and is expected to slip behind Japan in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 已经落后于英国、加拿大、法国、德国和意大利，预计在未来几周内将落后于日本。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the United States commemorated the 20th anniversary of the September 11th terror
sentences.zh: 周末，美国纪念了“9·11”恐怖袭击事件20周年，

sentences.en: attacks with ceremonies in Pennsylvania, Washington, and New York, where the names of those killed at the World Trade Center were read aloud by members of their families.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州、华盛顿和纽约举行了仪式，遇难者家属在仪式上朗读了在世界贸易中心遇难者的名字。

sentences.en: In a speech delivered from Shanksville, Pennsylvania, at the Flight 93 Memorial, former President George W.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州尚克斯维尔的93号航班纪念馆发表的演讲中，前总统乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush drew parallels between the foreign extremists who carried out the September 11th attacks and the domestic extremists who carried out the January 6th attack on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 布什将发动“9·11”袭击的外国极端分子与发动1月6日美国国会大厦袭击的国内极端分子进行了对比。

sentences.en: Capitol.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦。

sentences.en: There is little cultural overlap between violent extremists abroad and violent extremists at home.
sentences.zh: 国外的暴力极端分子与国内的暴力极端分子之间几乎没有文化重叠。

sentences.en: But in their disdainful pluralism, in their disregard for human life, in their determination to defile national symbols,
sentences.zh: 但在他们对多元主义的蔑视中，在他们对人类生命的漠视中，在他们玷污国家象征的决心上，

sentences.en: they are children of the same foul spirit, and it is our continuing duty to confront them.
sentences.zh: 他们是同一个邪恶灵魂的产物，对抗他们是我们持续的责任。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克和雷切尔·奎斯特制作。

sentences.zh: 由戴夫·肖和丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.zh: 原创音乐由布拉德·费舍尔、丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺创作。

sentences.en: And engineered by Alisha B'Etoop.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·贝图普进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
